name: daily-production-report
description: 每日生产报告 workflow — Hermes OS 自托管生产例程：仓库审计 → Registry 完整性 → 日报生成

steps.name: repo-state-audit
steps.intent: preflight 检查仓库状态 harness 预检 框架
steps.action: cd ~/Terence-Agent && echo "branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) dirty=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)"

steps.name: registry-integrity-check
steps.intent: 技能注册表 registry 完整性校验 skill 管理
steps.action: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/home/Terence/.hermes/skills/devops/skill-manager/references/skill-registry.json')); assert d['version']=='1.1.0' and len(d['skills'])==149 and len(d['forbidden_pairs'])==5, 'registry invalid'; print('registry v1.1 OK — 149 entries, forbidden_pairs=5')"

steps.name: daily-report-generation
steps.intent: 任务进度 日报 报告生成 progress 记录
